name: buffer_temp
brief:
Template buffer class for struct storage with linked sub-buffers

Provides Buffer<T, buff_size> template class that manages a linked list
of fixed-size arrays for efficient struct allocation. Used internally
by ADOL-C for external function descriptors and checkpointing data.

**Design:**
Buffers grow by allocating new SubBuffer nodes rather than reallocating,
avoiding pointer invalidation. Requires types with an `allmem` member
(enforced via AllMemType concept).
see: externfcts2.h for ext_diff_fct_v2 struct using this buffer
